58: Will engage in sexual intercourse with her and take her to him - that is to say, sexual intercourse with her constitutes taking her [as opposed to their being two separate things].

But perhaps [one can say that with regard to all matters] she is like a wife - just as with a wife, money and a document [act to bethroth] just as sexual intercourse; so too with a yevama, money and a document [act to betroth] just as sexual intercourse -- since it is written "[her brother-in-law will ... take her to him] as a wife" [Deuteronomy 25:5].
"And perform levirate marriage with her" - which connotes sexual intercourse. Scripture repeats it [another word with the root YBM] to preclude [any other forms of completing the levirate marriage].
